compiler_state.status: Epoch 2 complete — declarations and type-checking work. Function-body lowering to MIR not yet implemented.
what_works: sic-cli check: type-checks module-level declarations (structs, extern blocks, fn signatures)
sic-cli compile --target c: generates C stubs for all declared functions
extern "C" blocks: fully parsed and emitted as C extern declarations
Struct definitions: parsed, fields available for HM type inference
13 codegen backends: all generate stub skeletons
what_is_pending: Function bodies: parser skips bodies (body: vec![] always). All generated functions are empty stubs.
Working native binary: not possible until body lowering is implemented.
vec_new<T> body: stub only (malloc(16), no element-size tracking)
read_line body: stub only (malloc(1024), never reads stdin)

execution_model.current: Polyglot fallback — wifther.py (Python) is the running implementation.
execution_model.sic_files_role: Architecture spec + type declarations. Used by sic-cli for type checking. Will become executable when body lowering lands.
execution_model.run_mcp: python mcp_wifther.py  (stdio, called by Claude Code / Claude Desktop)

mcp_tools.scan_project: scan_project(directory_path: str) — full project scan, zero source tokens to Claude
mcp_tools.scan_single_file: scan_single_file(file_path: str) — single file by path, Claude never reads source
mcp_tools.scan_for_bugs: scan_for_bugs(file: str, source: str) — backward-compatible source-string scan

execution_model.token_model: scan_project sends only findings to Claude (O(bugs)), not source (O(lines))

modes.normal: Systems level, Polonius ownership checker, no GC. Requires explicit pointer management via extern C.

stdlib_actual.note: Real implementations are in WiftherAI/lib/std/. All functions return *void (raw pointer). High-level generics not available.
std::vector: vec_new<T>() -> *void  -- STUB: returns malloc(16), no generics
stdlib_actual.extern_c_preferred: For stdin/stdout/file I/O use extern "C" fgets/fread/printf directly.

wifther_architecture.analysis_engine: AST (ast.NodeVisitor) — no text search, no false positives from comments
patterns: MutableDefaultArg: ast.FunctionDef defaults containing ast.List/Dict/Set — includes diff
BareExceptPass: ast.ExceptHandler where type is None — includes diff
HardcodedSecret: ast.Assign where target name in SECRET_NAMES and value is str constant
DangerousFunction: ast.Call where func.id in {eval, exec}

commands.install_mcp: pip install mcp && claude mcp add wifther -- python mcp_wifther.py
